name: Medieval City of Rhodes
description: On the Greek island of Rhodes, this walled old town was rebuilt by the Knights of St John, who ruled it from 1309 to 1523 and turned it into a fortress. You can walk the Street of the Knights, past the Palace of the Grand Masters and the Great Hospital. In the Lower Town, Gothic buildings stand beside Ottoman mosques and public baths, all enclosed by a 4 km circuit of walls.
